notes.title: Big Language Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152893/152d46d02413057ffe2918f4b9850a230a25c831.png[/img]

Stunt Paradise is now localized in 21 languages! Our aim is to make the game accessible and enjoyable for players worldwide.

🌟 NEW Languages Include:

[list]
[*] Czech ✔

[*] Dutch ✔
[*] Hungarian ✔
[*] Japanese ✔

[*] Portuguese - Brazil ✔
[*] Romanian ✔

[*] Traditional Chinese ✔
[*] Turkish ✔
[/list]
Special thanks for the help with translations: Gökhan KOCAMAN (Turkish) and ru_i (Japanese).
🛠️ We've also squashed some pesky bugs in this update to ensure smoother gameplay.

In addition, we're offering a [b]20% discount on the game from May 2nd to May 9th[/b]! Don't miss out on this limited-time offer!

Explore the thrill of Stunt Paradise in your chosen language! 🚀

notes.title: Stunt Paradise - Racing game release!
notes.notes:
Stunt Paradise is now available on Steam, 15% off! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152893/b16c2103caea4fb5a10ae6c406bf227b2b401199.png[/img]

It is an epic racing game with extreme driving and crazy challenges!

The game fully supports Steam Deck, offering gamepad control with vibration, 120 FPS gameplay, achievements, cloud saves, and more! 🎉

Currently available on Windows and MacOS, we are also planning to introduce Linux support and localization for additional languages in the near future!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2435310/Stunt_Paradise/

Enjoy the game! 🙂

notes.title: Stunt Paradise - demo release!
notes.notes:
We've finally released the Stunt Paradise demo on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152893/0965956f467e2fbf28d688efd98b450989e84497.png[/img]

In the demo, 5 extreme levels are available with tricks, explosions, a lot of action, and all this to a driving musical rock accompaniment. There are also a couple dozen cars - from classic muscle cars to aggressive monster trucks.

Generally, the demo takes 15-20 minutes, which should be enough to familiarize yourself with the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2435310/Stunt_Paradise/ 

Stay tuned and add to the wishlist! 🙂
